propositions: A declared-none file impact should allow a signed plan attestation to remain valid after an unrelated HEAD commit without reverting to whole-HEAD freshness checks
Empty dependency paths with explicit none scope must classify distinctly from empty paths with unscoped status, which should still trigger stale-head on HEAD movement
The authenticated manifest must emit the line 'file-scope: none' only when scope is explicitly none; paths and unscoped manifests must produce byte-identical output to the pre-feature baseline

A none-scoped material fingerprint must include a canonical JSON basis member with file_impact_scope kind and reason, making reason-only edits stale while preserving legacy fingerprint compatibility for paths and unscoped
The recovery path via resign_plan_review must preserve none scope through the signing boundary without requiring changes to resign.py or the operational exports
